changelog: FIXED google_flow MCP: node extension host died with exit 13 the moment it touched crypto — termux-built node ships OpenSSL with the compiled-in /data/data/com.termux config path which is SELinux-blocked for this package. All node spawns (extension host, stdio MCP servers, plugin MCP servers, terminal login shells) now get OPENSSL_CONF pointed at this package's own usr/etc/tls/openssl.cnf
NEW Achiva Agent Control: the AI agent can now read and manage Achiva — new achiva_mcp MCP server (add via Settings → MCP → Quick Presets → 'Achiva Control') with 10 tools
achiva_get_state: see tasks, subjects/chapters, goals, good/bad habits, exams, study sessions and thoughts with a quick summary
achiva_add_task / achiva_toggle_task: plan tasks (one-time, daily/weekly/monthly/every-N-days, priority) and mark them done
achiva_add_subject / achiva_add_chapter / achiva_log_study: manage the subject tracker and log study sessions (backdated supported)
achiva_add_goal / achiva_add_habit / achiva_add_exam / achiva_add_thought: goals, habits, exam countdowns and text thoughts
Achiva bridge works in hosted-web mode too: the bridge script is injected into the Achiva page on every load
